author: Mark Thompson
text: Our treatment system alerted me that it was time for a clean out. After calling another local provider that was non-responsive, I found Affordable Septic Service.  Toni was easy to work with and lined up next day service for us.  The technician Vance was on time, friendly and professional.  The work was complete in about 30 minutes and he was on his way.  I will consider these guys my "go to" when septic needs arise and would recommend them to others.

author: Brent Bethel
text: I contacted Affordable Septic Services to have my septic tank inspected for any necessary repairs. Although their website clearly states that they perform these services, the representative told me that they only pump tanks and that I needed to contact the health department for the inspection and repairs. The health department has already visited the site and instructed me to have the tank and lines inspected by a company such as Affordable Septic Services. Very confused as of why their website says one thing and the representative says another.

author: Rob Calderwood
text: This is by far the best septic cleaning company I have ever used. I have had a lot of issues going on and have had to have my tank cleaned regularly. They are always very courteous, professional and a joy to work with. They are always out here before the time they say. Very affordable price and excellent service.

author: robert s
text: I've used Affordable Septic Service a couple times and have been very happy with their service. They return calls and messages promptly, show up on time and get the job done. If they're running late, they call and let you know, too. The driver was courteous and friendly and price was reasonable. Highly recommend and will definitely use in the future.

author: Debra K
text: The tech was very friendly.  He did the job quickly.  Reasonably priced.
